tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa kun tu bzang po'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ kaXrmaX bka' brgyud bstan pa'i snang byed mchog /ngaXg gi dbangaX phyug yoXn tanaX rgya~X che'i mtshoX/ /dge legs phrin las rlabs phreng kun tu khyab/ /dpal ldan bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshar gcod rjes 'dzin kun shes yan lag bcas/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la thos bsam dang*/ /sgom pa'i blo gros chags thogs bral ba yi/ /rnam dpyod mtha' yas ldan la gsol ba 'debs/ /paXd+maX dbang chen sogs kyis rjes su bzung*/ /garaX gyi dbangaX phyug thugs rje'i rig sngags 'chang*/ /phrinaX lasaX 'groX ba 'dulaX ba'i rtsalaX mnga' ba/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /grub rig 'dzin pa khyung gi gdung las grol/ /sbyangs pa'i las 'phro dkar po'i chos la sad/ /'khor lo gnyis kyi mthun rkyen ngang gi tshogs/ /ngo mtshar rmad du byung la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spong bas rgyud bsdams shing*/ /gzhan phan gzhir bcas bslab pa'i gnas la gzhol/ /rim gnyis mngon rtogs cir yang gsal ba yi/ /sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin par gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas grub ded dpon yongs 'dzin du ma bsten/ /mdo sngags rgya mtshor lhag bsam brtson pas zhugs/ /gzhung gdams man ngag nor bu'i skyes bzang gis/ /skal ldan dbul ba sel la gsol ba 'debs/ /o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rdo rje'i bka'/ /gter 'byin grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur rnams kyis/ /rnam snang bai ro tsa na'i rnam 'phrul du/ /lung bstan mnga' gsol mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba yab sras mchog gling mkhyen brtse'i dbang*/ /mchog gzigs rnams kyis tā ra nā tha dang*/ /'gyur med rdo rje'i sprul par zhal bzhes shing*/ /yongs 'dzin mchog tu bskur la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal bstan ris med skyong ba'i dag snang dang*/ /'gro phan ris med sgrub pa'i lhag bsam ste/

/gang byung thad kar khyer ba'i spyod tshul gyis/ /dam pa'i rnam thar 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi dben gnas su/ /tshe gcig sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs nas su/ /'chad rtsom bka' babs bstan la bya ba mdzad/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rjai'i lung gis gsal bar bsngags pa'i don/ /he ru ka yi sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ /bstan pa ji srid bar du 'gro phan gyi/ /btsas su bsgrubs par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /mos pa'i stobs dang rten 'brel bslu med mthus/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral zhing*/ /mkha' spyod grong khyer chen por lhan cig 'tshogs/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas mchog thob gyur cig /gang gi gsang gsum rdo rje ltar brtan cing*/ /zab rgyas mdzod lnga rtag tu sgrog pa yis/ /bdag sogs legs pa'i lam kun mthar phyin cing*/ /bsam don lhun 'grub dge legs dpal 'bar shog /bsngags 'os kyi yon tan cha shas phra mos kyang ma gos shing rang nyid la bstod pa ma rabs blun po'i lugs su gyur kyang*/ sgrub brtson bla ma dam pa pad+ma nor bus nan tan chen pos bskul ngo ma ldog tsam du 'du gsum pa yon tan rgya mtshos sug bris su bstar ba dge legs 'phel// //
